name: Oslow's Toolbox
summary: Foreman Oslow needs tools for Lakeshire's defenses, but they lie beneath Lake Everstill. Sent from Goldshire, the chest went down when Blackrock orcs struck its boat with a catapult.

sections.title: A Fateful Crossing
sections.body: Foreman Oslow needs construction tools to keep Lakeshire's defenses and buildings in repair. Blackrock orcs besiege the Redridge Mountains, and the bridge into town lies destroyed. The tools came from Goldshire, so the shipment crossed Lake Everstill in a rowboat. Blackrock forces struck the vessel with a catapult, sending the boat and Oslow's heavy chest into the depths among the murlocs.

faq.q: Why is Oslow's Toolbox at the bottom of the lake?
aliases: why is the toolbox in the water
how did oslow lose his tools
faq.answer: The tools were being carried from Goldshire to Lakeshire. With the bridge destroyed, the shipment crossed Lake Everstill by boat. Blackrock orcs struck the rowboat with a catapult, sinking it and sending the toolbox to the lakebed.
Foreman Oslow owns the toolbox and oversees construction and repairs in Lakeshire. Without proper equipment, keeping the town's fortifications in repair against ongoing attacks is nearly impossible.

faq.q: Where in Lake Everstill did the tools sink?
faq.answer: The tools rest in a sunken chest near the rowboat's wreckage in Lake Everstill. The chest lies among underwater boulders south of a prominent murloc encampment on the shore.

faq.q: What threats guard the sunken chest?
faq.answer: Hostile murlocs and predatory aquatic beasts infest the waters around the wreckage. Dangerous Lake Threshers prowl the deeper parts of the lake.

angles.text: Lakeshire stands nearly isolated under Blackrock siege. Recovering Oslow's supplies is crucial to keeping the town's defenses in repair.
